sources.snippet: Overview Vela 1.0 is a family of fourteen published model checkpoints for intelligent routing. The Router registry currently includes the Vela 307M encoder base and ten task models covering routing, prompt protection, content safety, retrieval and reranking. Each registered release is pinned to an immutable revision.
